crossRefs.note: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown…
Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says…
‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you, your servants, and your people who enter in by…
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
“Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
translations.bsb: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, all people of Judah and Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
translations.kjv: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
translations.asv: and say unto them, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
